note: Both sets correctly capture the page's headline values (KP(θ=0°)=0.01882681 s, KI(θ=0°)=0.008068634, KD=0.0 s², ζφ=0.7 as the upper limit of the recommended range) and both are padded with duplicated claims and fabricated chart readings that confuse the left axis (gain-correction factor, 0–1.0) with the right axis (gains, 0–0.025), e.g. 'Integral Gain 0.32 at 0°', 'Proportional Gain 0.8 s at 0°', 'Gain-Correction Factor 0.005 at 20°'. Set A makes fewer of these axis-confusion errors (e.g. it correctly reads the gain-correction factor as ~0.25 at 20° and the integral gain as 0.004 at 5°), but it also asserts the wrong integral gain at 0° (0.005) and misses Eq. (7-20). Set B uniquely and correctly records the gain-correction-factor law GK(θ)=1/(1+θ/θK) and the integral gain at 0° (0.008), but adds more unsupported chart estimates (0.75 s, 0.18 s, 0.08, 0.3, 0.015) and a wrong unit on KI. Netting A's extra wrong claims against B's extra wrong claims and B's unique correct formula, the two sets are about equally good.
